title: Bulkhead: Automated Semantic Detection and Remediation of Container Escape Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2607.12723v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Container filesystem isolation depends on safely resolving container-controlled paths during privileged host-container interactions. As third-party plugins and agent sandboxes introduce more interactions, unsafe path resolution can redirect host operations across isolation boundaries, expanding the attack surface for path traversal vulnerabilities. These logic flaws are difficult to mitigate: kernel defenses require intrusive redesign, static rules miss cross-boundary semantics, and manual auditing cannot scale. Large Language Model (LLM) based methods can detect syntax flaws through stable code patterns and identify logic flaws in domains such as smart contracts by comparing equivalent implementations. Container components, however, provide neither form of regularity: their heterogeneous interfaces operate under trust boundaries, filesystem views and interaction orders, making the security invariant difficult to find. translated_title: Bulkhead：容器逃逸漏洞的自动化语义检测与修复
translated_abstract: 容器文件系统隔离依赖于在特权的主机-容器交互过程中安全地解析容器控制的路径。随着第三方插件和智能体沙箱引入更多交互，不安全的路径解析可能使主机操作跨越隔离边界重定向，从而扩大了路径遍历漏洞的攻击面。这类逻辑缺陷难以缓解：内核防御需要侵入式的重新设计，静态规则会遗漏跨边界语义，而人工审计无法扩展规模。基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法可以通过稳定的代码模式检测语法缺陷，并通过比较等价实现来识别智能合约等领域的逻辑缺陷。然而，容器组件并不具备这两种规律性：其异构接口在信任边界、文件系统视图和交互顺序的约束下运行，导致安全不变量难以发现。
tldr: 该论文提出Bulkhead工具，利用大语言模型自动检测并修复由容器与主机间不安全路径解析导致的容器逃逸漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bulkhead, a tool that leverages large language models to automatically detect and remediate container escape vulnerabilities caused by unsafe cross-boundary path resolution.
